{"search_note":"I found good evidence that Abiy left a better macro-policy setup than he inherited: IMF program, FX reform, debt path, and some early stabilization effects.
I found weaker evidence that households actually experienced a stronger economy by late 2024. Inflation stayed high, poverty remained severe, and conflict/drought still crushed living standards.
I found no direct sanctions story that materially changes the assessment.
The fair synthesis is: trajectory improved at the policy level, but the lived economy remained weak and highly constrained.","evidence":[{"title":"IMF approves the stabilization package","publisher":"International Monetary Fund","date":"2024-07-29","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/07/29/pr24291-ethiopia-imf-exec-board-approves-4yr-us3b-ecf-arr","summary":"The IMF said the program was designed to correct macroeconomic imbalances, restore debt sustainability, tighten monetary policy, reform the exchange rate, and strengthen SOEs and fiscal governance. That is strong evidence that the government put the economy on a more credible medium-term trajectory.","question_ids":["5B.10","5B.6","5B.7","5B.9"]},{"title":"IMF says the program was advancing and the FX gap narrowed","publisher":"International Monetary Fund","date":"2024-09-27","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/09/27/pr-24348-ethiopia-imf-reaches-agreement-on-the-first-review-of-the-extended-credit-facility","summary":"The IMF said the exchange-rate regime had largely closed the official-parallel market gap with little disruption and macro stability was improving. This is strong positive evidence that Abiy left behind a more workable macro framework than the one he inherited.","question_ids":["5B.10","5B.6","5B.9"]},{"title":"IMF retrospective shows debt down and growth still positive","publisher":"International Monetary Fund","date":"2025-07-18","url":"https://www.elibrary.imf.org/view/journals/002/2025/188/article-A002-en.xml","summary":"The IMF reported total public debt fell from 40.2% of GDP a year earlier to 34.8% at end-June 2024, while 2023/24 growth was 8.1%. That supports a stronger end-2024 debt and growth position than the one Abiy started with, even after accounting for stress.","question_ids":["5B.10","5B.9","5B.6"]},{"title":"Inflation was still high, but trending down","publisher":"International Monetary Fund","date":"2025","url":"https://www.elibrary.imf.org/view/journals/002/2025/188/article-A001-en.xml","summary":"The IMF’s selected indicators show 2023/24 consumer-price inflation at 26.6%, with 2024/25 projected to fall to 16.6%. That is not a low-inflation success story yet, but it does indicate the reform path was moving the economy in the right direction.","question_ids":["5B.10","5B.9"]},{"title":"World Bank backs a more inclusive growth model","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-07-30","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/07/30/world-bank-backs-ethiopia-s-reforms-to-promote-sustainable-and-inclusive-afe-growth","summary":"The World Bank said the reform package aimed to strengthen financial stability, improve transparency, expand social safety nets, and support private-sector-led growth. That is positive evidence that the trajectory was being reset toward a more sustainable economy rather than short-term crisis management.","question_ids":["5B.10","5B.6","5B.8","5B.9"]},{"title":"World Bank says shock support was built in","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-03-29","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/03/29/world-bank-scales-up-efforts-to-boost-the-resilience-of-3-million-afe-ethiopians-living-in-drought-prone-lowlands","summary":"The Bank said 3 million people in drought-prone lowlands would receive new resilience support and explicitly linked the need to drought, floods, conflict, and environmental degradation. That is evidence the government’s trajectory had to be judged under severe external constraints, not a normal operating environment.","question_ids":["5B.10","5B.8","5B.9"]},{"title":"Climate report shows the inherited and continuing constraint load","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-02-28","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/02/28/climate-action-in-afe-ethiopia-acting-now-to-build-resilience-and-leverage-opportunities","summary":"The Bank said climate-related GDP losses were already running at 1 to 1.5 percent annually and could rise to 5 percent by the 2040s, with millions potentially pushed into poverty. This is important context: even competent policy could only partially offset such headwinds.","question_ids":["5B.10","5B.9","5B.6"]},{"title":"World Bank data confirms the macro picture remained fragile","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024","url":"https://data.worldbank.org/country/Ethiopia","summary":"Ethiopia’s 2024 data show GDP growth at 7.6%, inflation at 21.0%, and unemployment at 3.4%. Growth was real, but the economy was still under heavy price and employment stress, so “stronger trajectory” is only partly true in lived terms.","question_ids":["5B.10"]},{"title":"World Bank poverty assessment says living standards had deteriorated","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-10-01","url":"https://documents.worldbank.org/en/publication/documents-reports/documentdetail/099122324120026973","summary":"The assessment says poverty and living standards worsened after 2016 because of COVID-19, the Tigray conflict, droughts, and inflation. That is strong negative evidence against claiming the economy had clearly surpassed its inherited condition for ordinary households by year-end.","question_ids":["5B.10","5B.8","5B.9"]},{"title":"Reuters says the birr float was painful but corrective","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-07-29","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/ethiopia-shifts-to-marketbased-foreign-exchange-system-3540463","summary":"Reuters reported the birr fell about 30% when floated, against a backdrop of inflation, FX shortages, and debt default. The move was a necessary correction, but it also showed how fragile the inherited economy was and how costly the transition would be.","question_ids":["5B.10","5B.9"]},{"title":"Reuters says debt restructuring was still unfinished","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-07-30","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/ethiopias-imf-deal-paves-way-for-debt-restructuring-official-says-3543214","summary":"The IMF deal opened the route back to debt restructuring after a long delay. That is positive for trajectory, but it also shows Abiy inherited a severe debt problem and left it only partially resolved by year-end.","question_ids":["5B.10","5B.9"]},{"title":"Reuters/World Bank data show the external shock burden was real","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-10-01","url":"https://documents.worldbank.org/en/publication/documents-reports/documentdetail/099431210162414186","summary":"The World Bank noted liberalization could help growth and stability but emphasized pervasive fragility, poverty, and humanitarian needs. This supports a cautious judgment: the direction improved, but the economy was still not on a clearly strong trajectory in late 2024.","question_ids":["5B.10"]},{"title":"Food-aid diversion and insecurity undercut the end-state","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-01-12","url":"https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/ethiopia","summary":"HRW reported a widespread food-aid diversion scheme that led WFP and USAID to halt aid, restricting food access for about 20 million people. That is strong evidence that the broader economy and humanitarian system were still badly damaged.","question_ids":["5B.10","5B.8","5B.9"]},{"title":"Emergency rule and domestic conflict remained a drag on the economy","publisher":"Reuters, republished by KELO","date":"2024-02-02","url":"https://kelo.com/2024/02/02/ethiopia-extends-state-of-emergency-in-amhara/","summary":"Parliament extended emergency rule amid insurgency, deaths, and abuse allegations. That undercuts claims of a clean upward trajectory because it signals persistent instability and a poor investment environment.","question_ids":["5B.10","5B.5","5B.6","5B.9"]}]}
